name: MangaTX
_todo: Ported from keiyoushi Madara-family pattern; verify live selectors for https://mangatx.com.

Real keiyoushi Madara sources fetch popular/latest via an AJAX POST to /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php with action=madara_load_more, not simple GET pagination -- this port uses the plain GET fallback (?m_orderby=views&page=N) that older/simpler Madara sites still serve directly. If a specific site 404s on this, it needs the AJAX POST path, which this schema version doesn't support yet (no form_body/POST templating).

Some Madara sites gate chapter pages behind an AES-encrypted '#chapter-protector-data' blob (password + ciphertext, decrypted client-side in the app). This port only handles the plain page-list case; protected chapters will return an empty page list, not a fabricated success.

archiveSelector in the real source is 'div.page-item-detail, .manga__item, .c-tabs-item__content' (three alternatives, first match wins per site). This schema's selectors are single-string only, so 'div.page-item-detail' (the most common variant) was picked -- swap to '.manga__item' or '.c-tabs-item__content' if a specific site uses a different one.
